title: OpenCinema plugin market index
description: Static catalog served at <market>/index.json. The workbench fetches it, shows the entries, downloads the package at `url`, verifies `sha256` and `size`, then installs through the local Go server. Install only: entries are added by pull request.

displayName.description: Optional localized names keyed by BCP 47 tag, e.g. {"en":"Gaussian Splat","zh-CN":"高斯泼溅"}.

description.description: Localized one-sentence descriptions keyed by BCP 47 tag; en is required.

url.description: Absolute https URL, or a path relative to index.json, of the install.json package.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact install.json bytes at url.

minHost.description: Lowest OpenCinema version known to run this package.

agentGuide.description: True when the package carries an agent.md guide.
